note: This is the schema shape used by vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector, Chroma) for image similarity search / RAG. The 'vector' field is a placeholder — a real embedding requires running the image through a model (e.g. CLIP) which needs a GPU/model runtime this environment doesn't have. Your Qdrant setup or LM Studio rig can generate this.

payload.name: Steampunk Celestial Orrery
payload.description: A brass clockwork cityscape of gears, spires, and a clock face rising from a purple nebula starfield inside a glass sphere, mounted on an ornate brass tripod stand amid dark mineral gravel, with blurred leather-bound books in the background.
